---
title: "Kept tables after a part-filled page"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

A kept block holding a table went to the next page whole, with a page break
inside it before the table: longtable measured the page the block was read
on. Each block below follows a paragraph a little longer than the last, so
one of them meets the foot of a page whatever the face.

The block moves whole to the next page when what is left of this one cannot hold it and the table.

::: {.keep}
